record.bible_text: Cry<WH07121><WTH8798> aloud<WH01627>, spare<WH02820><WTH8799> not, lift<WH07311><WTH8685> up thy voice<WH06963> like a trumpet<WH07782>, and shew<WH05046><WTH8685> my people<WH05971> their transgression<WH06588>, and the house<WH01004> of Jacob<WH03290> their sins<WH02403>. <RF>aloud: Heb. with the throat<Rf>

Wherefore have we fasted<WH06684><WTH8804>, <FI>say they<Fi> , and thou seest<WH07200><WTH8804> not? <FI>wherefore<Fi> have we afflicted<WH06031><WTH8765> our soul<WH05315>, and thou takest no knowledge<WH03045><WTH8799>? Behold, ye fast<WH06684><WTH8799> for strife<WH07379> and debate<WH04683>, and to smite<WH05221><WTH8687> with the fist<WH0106> of wickedness<WH07562>: ye shall not fast<WH06684><WTH8799> as <FI>ye do this<Fi>  day<WH03117>, to make your voice<WH06963> to be heard<WH08085><WTH8687> on high<WH04791>. <RF>ye shall...: or, ye fast not as this day<Rf>

Is it such a fast<WH06685> that I have chosen<WH0977><WTH8799>? a day<WH03117> for a man<WH0120> to afflict<WH06031><WTH8763> his soul<WH05315>? <FI>is it<Fi> to bow down<WH03721><WTH8800> his head<WH07218> as a bulrush<WH0100>, and to spread<WH03331><WTH8686> sackcloth<WH08242> and ashes<WH0665> <FI>under him<Fi> ? wilt thou call<WH07121><WTH8799> this<WH02088> a fast<WH06685>, and an acceptable<WH07522> day<WH03117> to the LORD<WH03068>? <RF>a day...: or, to afflict his soul for a day?<Rf>

<FI> Is<Fi> not this the fast<WH06685> that I have chosen<WH0977><WTH8799>? to loose<WH06605><WTH8763> the bands<WH02784> of wickedness<WH07562>, to undo<WH05425><WTH8687> the heavy<WH04133> burdens<WH092>, and to let the oppressed<WH07533><WTH8803> go<WH07971><WTH8763> free<WH02670>, and that ye break<WH05423><WTH8762> every yoke<WH04133>? <RF>the heavy...: Heb. the bundles of the yoke<Rf> <RF>oppressed: Heb. broken<Rf>

<FI> Is it<Fi> not to deal<WH06536><WTH8800> thy bread<WH03899> to the hungry<WH07457>, and that thou bring<WH0935><WTH8686> the poor<WH06041> that are cast out<WH04788> to thy house<WH01004>? when thou seest<WH07200><WTH8799> the naked<WH06174>, that thou cover<WH03680><WTH8765> him; and that thou hide<WH05956><WTH8691> not thyself from thine own flesh<WH01320>? <RF>cast...: or, afflicted<Rf><CM>

Then shall thy light<WH0216> break forth<WH01234><WTH8735> as the morning<WH07837>, and thine health<WH0724> shall spring forth<WH06779><WTH8799> speedily<WH04120>: and thy righteousness<WH06664> shall go<WH01980><WTH8804> before<WH06440> thee; the glory<WH03519> of the LORD<WH03068> shall be thy rereward<WH0622><WTH8799>. <RF>be...: Heb. gather thee up<Rf>

Then shalt thou call<WH07121><WTH8799>, and the LORD<WH03068> shall answer<WH06030><WTH8799>; thou shalt cry<WH07768><WTH8762>, and he shall say<WH0559><WTH8799>, Here I <FI>am<Fi> . And <FI>if<Fi> thou draw out<WH06329><WTH8686> thy soul<WH05315> to the hungry<WH07457>, and satisfy<WH07646><WTH8686> the afflicted<WH06031><WTH8737> soul<WH05315>; then shall thy light<WH0216> rise<WH02224><WTH8804> in obscurity<WH02822>, and thy darkness<WH0653> <FI>be<Fi> as the noonday<WH06672>:

And <FI>they that shall be<Fi> of thee shall build<WH01129><WTH8804> the old<WH05769> waste places<WH02723>: thou shalt raise up<WH06965><WTH8787> the foundations<WH04146> of many<WH01755> generations<WH01755>; and thou shalt be called<WH07121><WTH8795>, The repairer<WH01443><WTH8802> of the breach<WH06556>, The restorer<WH07725><WTH8789> of paths<WH05410> to dwell in<WH03427><WTH8800>.<CM>

If thou turn away<WH07725><WTH8686> thy foot<WH07272> from the sabbath<WH07676>, <FI>from<Fi> doing<WH06213><WTH8800> thy pleasure<WH02656> on my holy<WH06944> day<WH03117>; and call<WH07121><WTH8804> the sabbath<WH07676> a delight<WH06027>, the holy<WH06918> of the LORD<WH03068>, honourable<WH03513><WTH8794>; and shalt honour<WH03513><WTH8765> him, not doing<WH06213><WTH8800> thine own ways<WH01870>, nor finding<WH04672><WTH8800> thine own pleasure<WH02656>, nor speaking<WH01696><WTH8763> <FI>thine own<Fi>  words<WH01697>:

Then shalt thou delight<WH06026><WTH8691> thyself in the LORD<WH03068>; and I will cause thee to ride<WH07392><WTH8689> upon the high places<WH01116> of the earth<WH0776>, and feed<WH0398><WTH8689> thee with the heritage<WH05159> of Jacob<WH03290> thy father<WH01>: for the mouth<WH06310> of the LORD<WH03068> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi> .<CM>
